questions.title: Sync: local-first, or a hosted database?
questions.blocks: The data layer and the sign-in screens.
context: Households share one chore list on 2 to 6 phones. Edits must merge when two people change the list offline.
Local-first (SQLite on each phone plus a sync service for merges) works offline and costs about USD 0 to 20 a month. It takes about 2 weeks more to build.
A hosted database (a managed Postgres with live queries) is faster to build, but the app shows a spinner with no connection, and the cost grows with each household.

options.label: A. Local-first
options.detail: Offline always works. About 2 weeks more.

options.label: B. Hosted database
options.detail: Faster to build. Needs a connection.

options.label: C. Hosted now, local-first in 2.0
options.detail: Ship sooner; a data migration later.

questions.recommendation: A. Offline use is the main complaint in the reviews of the apps we compared, and a later migration costs more than the 2 weeks.

questions.title: Onboarding: three short screens, or one screen?
context: The first-run test with 5 people: 2 people skipped the three-screen version at screen 2 and did not find the invite button.
The one-screen version puts the invite button first and explains chores with an example list.

options.label: Three screens
options.detail: Keep, but move the invite to screen 1.

questions.recommendation: One screen. Fewer taps before the first invite, and it was faster in the test.

questions.title: App icon: which sketch goes to the designer?
context: Three sketches. All read at 29 pt on the home screen. The kettle is the most distinctive in the store search for 'chores'.

options.label: Kettle
options.detail: Warm, and no other chores app uses it.

options.label: Check mark
options.detail: Simple, but looks like a to-do app.

questions.title: Release notes: playful or plain?
context: The store shows the first two lines. Playful notes get more reads in some studies, but they hide the fix list.

options.label: Playful
options.detail: One fun line, then the list.

questions.recommendation: Plain, with one short friendly line at the end.

questions.title: Reminders: push notifications, or only in-app?
context: Reminders are the main reason people open a chores app.

options.label: Push, opt-in after the first chore

questions.recommendation: Push, asked after the first chore is done.
questions.decision: D-012: push notifications, asked after the first chore is done. One reminder a day at most.

autodecided.title: Date formats
autodecided.decision: Use the platform Intl API for dates and times.
autodecided.reason: No new dependency; it covers all the locales we ship.

autodecided.title: Lint rules
autodecided.decision: Use the recommended preset of the linter, with no custom rules.

autodecided.title: Test runner
autodecided.decision: Use the built-in test runner of the platform.
autodecided.reason: One less dependency; fast enough for our test count.
